frequency_question: How often do nations under invasion successfully establish domestic missile production lines within a two-year window when initial advance signals are observed?
membership_rule: Includes sovereign states under active foreign invasion initiating indigenous cruise missile or advanced precision-guided munition production; excludes peacetime co-production agreements.

cases.name: Ukraine domestic Neptune cruise missile mass production
Ukraine domestic FPV drone industrial scaling

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named major indigenous defence manufacturing scaling efforts in Ukraine since 2022; baseline reflects extreme necessity adaptation.
known_gaps: Complex Western cruise missile integration (SCALP/Storm Shadow) involves proprietary software and specialized solid rocket/turbojet components distinct from simpler airframes, potentially lowering the direct historical analog rate.
skeleton: Total wartime indigenous missile/artillery production scaling events in the post-Soviet invasion context
multiplier: 4 hits out of 4 documented major indigenous systems attempted under active pressure
validity_reason: Wartime innovation and industrial decentralization rates remain relatively stable for the duration of the current high-intensity conflict.
